occupancy_domain.primitive: FG footprint/capture domain centered on current XY
occupancy_domain.overlap: runtime presentation may overlap capture halos; canonical centers remain distinct

shape_equivalence.scale: fixed by board FG footprint; not a game-state degree of freedom

soft_snap.animation: spring/magnetic interpolation from current pose to exact canonical witness
lock_requires: 3D orientation/face compatibility on every required cycle edge

closure.source_compatibility: every required edge must exist in the immutable Cycle-1 compatibility corpus
closure.extra_compatible_pairs: secondary/presentation potential; not required for witness closure
closure.linear_shapes: cycle-closing long-span edge is rendered as a coherence tether rather than literal footprint contact

orientation.rule: For each required witness edge, runtime selects/validates a source-supplied compatible face pair. All required edges must be simultaneously satisfiable by the current orientations.
orientation.note: This contract freezes 2D witnesses. Exact face-pair orientation witnesses are solved from the existing compatibility corpus in Pass 3B; source QMO data is not rewritten.

provenance.authority: RAEON runtime realization design; does not modify source QMO identities or mathematics
